desc: Derive and prove the query cost formula, including the case where the endpoint blocks are connected at `min(Y,Z)`.
Build a maximum spanning tree via descending-weight DSU over grid edges.
Implement compact binary-lifting preprocessing on the MST for minimum-edge-on-path bottleneck queries, with same-block handling.
Implement the complete Python stdin/stdout solution and verify it passes the supplied sample.
Check worst-case time and memory bounds for `HW <= 250000`, roughly `500000` edges, and `Q <= 200000`.
